 Follow Bill Murray spends Halloween at a Yonkers bar
 Jeanne Muchnick, Rockland/Westchester Journal News Updated Wed, November 4, 2026 at 9:03 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. It was a treat, not a trick at Rory Dolan's in Yonkers when actor/comedian Bill Murray showed up on Halloween.
 The McLean Avenue bar is continually festive — owner Rory Dolan hosts a party no matter what night Halloween falls on, but this being a Saturday, it was particularly celebratory. And all the more so when Murray came in with two friends, ate dinner (he had rib-eye and a nice bottle of wine), and later, helped pour Guinness from behind the bar.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Dolan said he was friendly with customers, many of whom approached him to talk about their favorite movies of his. Dolan, meanwhile, discussed golf courses around the world with him, including prime spots in Ireland.
 Murray also told Dolan he wanted to check out his place because of its reputation as having great energy.
 Murray's sighting, which Dolan displayed on his restaurant's Instagram page, was the latest in a string of celebrity spottings this fall. J-Lo was seen at Coffee Unique in Bronxville getting coffee while New York Knicks Point Guard Jalen Brunson, a Scarsdale resident and Laughing Horse regular, was seen in Harrison.
